text:
sam: FYI ran the sampleapp onboarding stress run and hit a nasty interaction between prefetch + pagination. We saw a sudden spike of 429s and the client kept queuing pages, memory climbed. Repro: new org, concurrent users ~15, sampleapp with prefetch on. :grimacing:

amy: ouch. which language sampleapp? any stack traces?

sam: nextjs (js sdk). logs show repeated `WARN page-fetch status=429` entries and a growing in-flight queue. config used:```yaml
page_size: 40
prefetch: 6
client_window: 20
max_concurrency: 10
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 3
  base_backoff_ms: 150
```

kelvin: interesting. our go/python clients have a smoothing token-bucket that naturally throttles prefetch while js uses a semaphore that doesn't reduce inflight when 429s arrive. parity gap.

amy: two angles: quick mitigation in sampleapp + longer SDK parity fix. quick idea: clamp prefetch to a function of client_window and throttle it down on sustained 429s.

sam: I prototyped a clamp locally:```js
const clamp = Math.max(1, Math.floor(config.client_window / 5));
prefetch = Math.min(config.prefetch, clamp);
```
That already reduced the 429 burst and stabilized memory.

kelvin: also make retries exponential with jitter and have the retry handler notify the prefetch controller to decrement aggressive targets. Eg on repeated 429s reduce effective prefetch by 50% for 30s.

amy: agree. can we add a small circuit-breaker that pauses prefetch when 429 rate > 15% over 20s, then ramp back slowly? That would help small accounts hitting cold caches.

sam: yes. I'll add an experimental `prefetchCircuit` toggle to sampleapp and put it behind `DEBUG_PREFETCH=true`. Will open a draft PR with the change + an e2e that simulates spike.

ci-bot: integration tests for `devex/sampleapp` reported 1 flake: timeout in `prefetch_flow` test. See https://ci/reports/4982

amy: thanks CI. Sam, please add a deterministic e2e harness that fakes 429 responses so CI can validate behavior without timing fuzz.

sam: on it. also filing an SDK parity issue: go+py smoothing vs js semaphore difference, recommending we align semantics or document differences.

kelvin: add a short diagnostic header `X-RW-Prefetch-Debug: true` that logs inflight/pending counts — useful for support to triage without full traces. Put it behind an env var.

amy: and update the devex docs: client-side throttling section should call out prefetch/clamping, circuit rules, and sampleapp recommendations for early-stage accounts.

sam: draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/499 (WIP) — includes clamp, simple circuit, debug header, and a synthetic e2e. ETA: EOD.

kelvin: once merged, let's add a small telemetry metric (prefetch_pauses) so we can measure how often this happens in production.

amy: good idea. also include a note in the JS SDK changelog that this is experimental and subject to API for telemetry.

sam: will do. pinging here when PR is ready.

kelvin: filing the parity ticket now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1021 — tagging @sdk-team for input on semaphore->bucket migration in js.

amy: thanks. short-term: recommend customers set `prefetch: 1` for small orgs in onboarding docs until we ship a more robust update. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks team.
